hypothesis: A factual A,-A,A action-contrast acquired at staggered actual observation times supplies an affine-drift-orthogonal action-effect estimate that a learned gate may combine with the P43 recurrent prediction; speculative branches never update memory.

mechanism.model: Original P43 plus P43-R1 rank readiness, bounded latest-three completed observed actions/timestamps/outcomes, persistent factual contrast effect and trainable blend gate
mechanism.intervention_condition: same nonzero outer actions, exactly opposite middle action, strictly increasing factual observation times
mechanism.state_updates: only caller-authenticated actual action and outcome
mechanism.current_effect_memory: latest valid contrast preserved through intervening non-ABA facts
mechanism.blend: learnable scalar sigmoid gate with zero contribution until factual contrast available

dev_fixture.scope: Explicit analytic development fixtures, not independently born source; no optimizer training or heldout science
dev_fixture.negative_quadratic_nuisance: Known bias must be detected and retained, not tuned away
dev_fixture.negative_constant_actions: No ABA effect evidence; P43-R1 rank still abstains
dev_fixture.negative_wrong_action_label: No imaginary causal evidence from only candidate preview
dev_fixture.strong_conventional_ABA: Must be recorded as a perfect tie on affine source; no superiority claim

constraints: fully converged conventional GRU and MLP
strong fitted P42 and ABA estimators
